sub_agent_reviews.summary: One unified Scout agent was spawned for llm-agent, llm-post-training, and ai-safety; it timed out and was closed, then the main process completed one merged candidate pass and selected arXiv 2606.20023 after local dedupe.
Main agent read the arXiv PDF/source package and TeX sections, extracting ToolPrivBench construction, OPUR/PED metrics, model results, mitigation training details, reward design, and limitations.
Related context was checked against same-day known links and prior AI safety agent items; the paper was not a duplicate and fills the least-privilege tool-selection gap.
Markdown contains self-contained TL;DR, tables, formulas, pseudocode, Mermaid, localized evidence figures, and an explicit boundary analysis.
